notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Gyre Sage.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
